name: Al Muta’ali
description: Allah is supremely exalted, beyond every imperfection and comparison with His creation.
summary: Al Muta'ali refers to Allah's nature of being beyond all limitations and imperfections, highlighting His greatness and the fact that He is above anything that can be imagined or compared. The name inspires reverence and acknowledgment of Allah's unique status as the Creator, who is exalted above all that exists.
